subject: [PATCH v4 12/19] selftests/mm: parameterize the mixed-source collapse case by source order

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch parameterizes the mixed-source collapse case in the selftests/mm suite by introducing a new source order parameter. The test faults at this specified order, keeping order 2 as default when absent. This allows for testing of larger mTHP orders on arm64/64K configurations. The change is made to the khugepaged.c file and does not affect other mTHP cases.
